Overall Reflection

How I've grown

I started from understanding polynomial functions, into expanding my knowledge of calculus by finding the derivatives, using basic differentiation with its different rules (constant rule, power rule, chain rule, etc.), and applying integration on trigonometric and exponential functions.

Competencies gained

Calculus has helped me improve my problem-solving skills, critical thinking and even familiarizing it as it is connected to my Cybersecurity Course.

Short-term goals

I aim to improve my memorization in the different methods and solutions for my next semester's mathematical subject.

Long-term goals

Continue to improve my skills in Calculus to better understand cryptography in Cybersecurity.
